body:
The `skgo-project` site is a real skgo v0.9.1 application configured for Vite+ (`web/vite.config.ts` has `fmt` and `lint`). I built the CLI from the v0.9.1 tag and ran `skgo check -root site -json` against it after building the frontend.

The report has seven `complete` entries: goimports, svelte-check, go-build, go-vet, staticcheck, skgo-advice, and skgo. The two failed entries are:

- prettier: `project Prettier is missing; install/configure prettier and prettier-plugin-svelte`
- eslint: `project ESLint is missing; install/configure eslint and eslint-plugin-svelte`

The site's own `vp check` now exits zero, so the frontend's configured formatter, linter, and type checker do run. A fresh Vite+ skgo app should be checkable without adding a second formatter and linter solely to satisfy `skgo check`. Please make the unified command use the project's Vite+ check when configured, preserving a failed/incomplete report when any part is missing or fails. The project dashboard is adding separate named outcomes for the tagged CLI and Vite+ runs; the CLI outcome will stay red until this works.

**Triage — 2026-10-18**

Checked against current [`main` at `920b6aca`](https://github.com/tylergannon/skgo/tree/920b6aca738a65d6c046a67f4db2373596fafd03). Classification: `bounded-hard`. 

The checking command is shipped, and internal/check now uses VitePlus; the old Prettier/ESLint-only complaint and WIP boundary are stale. The explicit --fix requirement remains absent: Options has no fix mode and Run is documented as non-editing. Keep open for deliberate fix-mode ownership, applicable-file changes, honest missing-tool results and recheck behavior. Scope the work to that residual capability instead of implementing another unified checker.
